newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIAN POPULATION FELL TO 1.46 MLN IN 1996.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIAN POPULATION FELL TO 1.46 MLN IN 1996.

text.p: Estonia's population was 1.462 million at the beginning of 1997, compared to 1.476 million a year before, the statistics office said on Thursday.
During 1996, 13,291 people were born and 19,020 people died, it added in a statement.
The statistics office also said that 5,517 marriages and 5,675 divorces were registered in 1996, while 1,557 immigrants and 7,241 emigrants were registered during the year.
